ledger_identity.reading: every close the broker performed is in ``exits``, including the ones the engine performs inside its own cycle, and every opening the broker performed is in ``fills``, including the ones that never survived to a book snapshot. An opening with no close is a position still open when the replay ended, and its count is ``open_positions_at_end``

execution_class_reading: historical bars driven through the canonical paper path; this is real execution of the runtime's code but NOT prospective observation, because every bar predates the run
limitations: a sandbox ledger is not an admission: the fills of the sandbox arm certify connectivity, never admissibility
one dataset, two symbols, one timeframe, one family: enough to diagnose the path, not enough to infer an edge
fills are modelled by PaperBroker at bar OHLC with its own slippage and commission, not by venue data
